title: Apply for a Temporary Excess Provision of Services (TEPS) permit
summary: Apply for a Temporary Excess Provision of Services (TEPS) permit if you need to supply more security operators than your current master licence allows.
intro:
A security master licence authorises the holder to provide a specific number of people to carry out security activities.

If you need to supply more security operators than you're licensed for, you can apply for a Temporary Excess Provision of Services (TEPS) permit for a specified time period.

You need to submit your application at least 24 hours before providing additional security people.

You can apply online for a TEPS permit.
who_can_apply: Must hold a current master licence.
what_you_need: A OneGov account or MyServiceNSW Account

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to complete your application.
Download and complete the Application for temporary excess provision of services request form – PDFNote: You can only make payment by Mastercard or Visa.
Send the form by email or post to the address noted on the form.

internal_links.text: Check a security Temporary Excess Provision of Services permit

faqs.q: How far in advance do I need to apply for a TEPS permit?
faqs.a: You must submit your application at least 24 hours before providing additional security people.

faqs.q: What is required to apply for a TEPS permit?
faqs.a: You must hold a current master licence.

faqs.q: How can I apply for a TEPS permit?
faqs.a: You can apply online for a TEPS permit. Alternatively, you can download and complete the Application for temporary excess provision of services request form – PDF and send it by email or post.
